reserveReview.rationale: Re-verified 2026-08-23. COTI's overcollateralization FAQ states "DJED uses exogenous collateral (ADA)" and explains that ADA is used to buy SHEN; its minting and burning FAQ describes the 400%-800% reserve-ratio guards and states that DJED can be burned. A Cardano mainnet Koios POST /api/v1/address_info read for the named Djed reserve script address addr1z8mcpc26j64fmhhd6sv5qj5mk9xqnfxgm6k8zmk7h2rlu4qm5kjdmrpmng059yellupyvwgay2v0lz6663swmds7hp0qhxg9gt returned balance 28,300,277,449,032 lovelace (=28,300,277.449032 ADA); the newest UTxO in that response is at block 13,840,791. A same-session Koios /tip read returned Cardano block 13,846,947. The current read corroborates a single ADA reserve envelope; it does not establish an independent liability reconciliation or custody/legal terms.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: COTI Djed ADA collateral disclosure corroborated by Cardano mainnet Koios address_info read on 2026-08-23

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Reserves are ADA locked at a dedicated Cardano script address with no custodian; the current Koios address_info read returned 28,300,277.449032 ADA, with the newest returned UTxO at block 13,840,791. COTI has not officially published the contract addresses, the inventory comes from the community-maintained open-djed registry, and the pre-launch audit COTI announced was never published with an auditor name or report. Legal bankruptcy-remoteness and rehypothecation terms do not apply to script custody; the reserve is delegated (staked) but not lent out.
